description: Shows the website Humfrid made for you at your own domain, in two steps so it never goes down: first www and the certificate for your bare domain, then your bare domain. Your email and every other record stay as they are.
variableDescription: proof: the token after humfrid-verify= that proves this domain belongs to the Humfrid workspace that asked; certid: the label Google Certificate Manager gives the certificate authorization record of the bare domain; certtoken: the labels before .authorize.certificatemanager.goog in its target
